name: Thanksgiving
note: Autumn leaf border for the two weeks before Thanksgiving. Thanksgiving is the 4th Thursday of November (Nov 22 to 28), so this runs through Nov 28 every year. The video is unchanged.

name: Christmas
note: Swaps the Screen 3 video for December. To also draw a holiday overlay, type a file name from web/assets/overlays/ in the overlay column. Dates like 12-01 repeat every year; 2026-12-01 is one time only
